title: Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing
description:
Airswift is looking for a Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing (Hybrid and Offshore)
to work on a 12-month assignment in Rio de Janeiro with a major oil and gas company.
The Professional will provide specialized technical support in deepwater exploration and appraisal well testing to the well team in Brazil. The Senior Well Testing Technical Specialist will be responsible for technical design, detailed engineering, and operational supervision activities in the field to safely and reliably design, plan, and execute E&A well testing scopes in Brazil, in compliance with all local regulations and relevant company and industry standards. The professional will work with a multidisciplinary and international team to ensure the safe delivery of all technical and commercial objectives for the complex and challenging deepwater E&A well testing scopes. This will include, among other activities, addressing process safety and operational risks, providing reliable technical engineering designs, developing detailed operational procedures, and providing supervision and monitoring of offshore operations at the well site.
Job Responsibilities
In this role the Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing will:
Work as part of a team, under the direction of the Well Discipline Lead and Regional Wells Superintendent
Promote a strong safety culture across all well testing activities, focusing on inherently safer designs, process safety, procedural discipline, adherence to standards and collaboration with key stakeholders
Manage and work collaboratively with well testing and drilling teams and associated contractors to develop safe and reliable designs and robust and detailed operational procedures.
Lead and coordinate management of regional resources and activity with direct input from regional and functional management and engineering teams.
Oversight of contractual and technical conformance of the service providers and ensuring time and cost budgets are accurately forecasted and spending is appropriately monitored and controlled.
Review operational failure incidents, analyse root cause effects and present findings to ensure a positive learning culture.
Write deep technical reports, basis of designs, well programmes, work instructions and other documentation in English and be computer literate with relevant office and technical software packages
Manage and support HAZard IDentification, HAZard OPerability studies and Layers Of Protection Analysis, HSE risk assessments, well operations reviews, certification and design engineering reviews.
Integrate service providers and client demands to deliver safe, efficient and compliant operations.
Interface with the rig personnel on preparation of SIMOPS, TWOPs and safety critical and operational procedures.
Provide onshore logistical and operational support for regional activity as required.
Report directly to and provide technical support and safety advice to the Well Site Leaders during offshore execution
Lead and supervise site based Well Testing and related operations as required; ensuring systems are installed, commissioned and operated as per approved design and programme.
Provide quality control and quality assurance for all the well test and fluid data acquisition activities at site.
Perform end of well reporting and financial reconciliation, capturing lessons learnt and driving continuous improvement plans and initiatives.
Job Qualifications
Experience in deepwater well testing, including experience in operators and the service sector in the design, planning, and direct supervision of deepwater exploration and appraisal (E&A) well testing operations. Prior experience in process safety, including HAZIDs, HAZOPs, and LOPAs, and their application in improving the safety and reliability of well testing operations. Prior experience in design assurance and supervision of safety systems and critical safety equipment for deepwater, subsea, and surface well testing.
Bachelor's degree required.
Advanced English - Required.
Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).
BOSIET or HUET training applicable for locations requiring helicopter transport to the well.
About Airswift
Airswift serves as a strategic partner to our clients in STEM industries. We offer a turnkey workforce solution to acquire, mobilise and employ top talent in over 70 countries. With 800 employees in over 60 offices worldwide, 7,000 contractors and a candidate database of 1.5m specialists, our geographical reach and pool of available talent, experience and expertise is unmatched in the industry. We are proud to serve as a trusted advisor to clients looking to expand their operations internationally and offer employer of record services, payroll outsourcing, as well as HR consulting.

title: Associate Risk Consultant
description:
The Associate Risk Consultant will work a 40-hour work week. This will typically be regular hours (M-F 07:00AM - 4:00PM) but may fluctuate slightly depending on the client's requirements.
The Associate Risk Consultant is responsible for providing support, advice and monitoring to a single (or maximum two) dedicated Control Risks ONE client(s). This position will interact with the client(s) directly and will require the candidate to provide general security support, risk monitoring, and updates proactively as well as be able to reactively respond to client queries. This position will be the primary point of contact for the requirements of the clients to ensure their needs are met by Control Risks ONE.
Role tasks and responsibilities
Client support and liaison: Provide expert guidance and act as a key liaison between Control Risks ONE and dedicated client in high-stress environments, managing security-related incidents and inquiries.
Tailored security solutions: Respond promptly to client requests, delivering bespoke verbal and written security assessments and recommendations based on a deep understanding of their operations, while ensuring proactive crisis management and coordination.
Intelligence and security risk consulting: Collect, evaluate, and disseminate relevant open-source and proprietary information, preparing comprehensive threat intelligence reports and risk assessments. Monitor global events and forecast operational impacts to the client based on bespoke escalation protocols and risk registers.
Crisis management and provider identification: Support Control Risks crisis management teams and evacuation operations by maintaining situational awareness of crises and identifying security providers to ensure rapid response and client safety.
Client account management: Serve as the primary point of contact for the dedicated account.
Requirements
Education and experience: Bachelor's degree in international relations, politics, security studies, criminal justice or a related field, OR equivalent work experience. Minimum of 2-3 years' experience in a professional environment related to threat or intelligence analysis or security industry-related. - Preferred: Previous experience working for a GSOC or in the extractive sector
Languages: Native or equivalent fluency in Portuguese and English; both written and spoken. Proficiency in Spanish is preferred.
Crisis management: Proven ability to remain calm and effective in high-stress environments.
Global awareness: Broad knowledge of global geopolitical affairs and the ability to assess operational impacts across various sectors and industries
Analytical skills: Strong aptitude for interpreting data sources, with excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
Customer service excellence: Outstanding customer service skills, with a strong focus on client satisfaction.
Collaborative team player: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese, with the ability to adapt communication styles to suit different audiences and cultures. Fluency in a language other than English and Portuguese is desired, but not required
Adaptability: Ability to be responsive to changing requirements and adaptable to unpredictable circumstances, with a demonstrated capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Discretion: Ability to act discreetly and apply company policies appropriately to inform decisions and actions.

title: Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
You'll help design and operate the hybrid (on-prem + cloud) infrastructure that powers Siemens Energy's industrial digitalization solutions. With solid experience in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of GCP and AWS, you'll contribute to building secure, reliable, and scalable connections between industrial (OT) environments and cloud platforms, enabling data services, analytics, and smarter operations

Deploy and maintain cloud and edge components for data ingestion, storage, and monitoring.

Security-by-design approach (identity, secrets management, policy-as-code, vulnerability management, compliance).
Effective collaborator communication with multi-functional and international teams.
Degree in Engineering (any), Computer Science, or proven equivalent experience.
Proficient English, knowledge of other languages is an asset.
Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, AWS) are a plus.
Familiarity with edge runtimes (Azure IoT Edge, Kubernetes at the edge), time-series/observability stacks.

title: Overlay Cluster Manager
description:
Department: Technical & Infrastructure
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.
Role to transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during final Event.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.
YOUR PROFILE
Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
Right to work in Brazil
Fluency in English and Portuguese; additional language(s) is an asset.
Availability to travel as needed
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista Controle de Qualidade IIIRio de Janeiro
description:
Job Description
Para nós da M. Dias Branco, a qualidade de vida no ambiente de trabalho, bem como, o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, são considerados fatores primordiais para o sucesso.
Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos e na construção de um clima organizacional favorável ao alcance dos resultados. Estamos sempre em busca de bons profissionais para integrar à nossa equipe nas mais diversas áreas e unidades.
Nossas marcas: Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras, são conhecidas nos mais diversos mercados que atuamos e levam a qualidade da M. Dias Branco para a mesa de milhões de famílias brasileiras. Cada marca ocupa uma posição de destaque em seus mercados, conquistando diversos prêmios em pesquisas junto aos consumidores.
Missão Do Cargo
Executar, sob supervisão moderada, tarefas de média complexidade, relacionadas às análises físico-químicas e microbiológicas dos produtos, programas de segurança de alimentos, bem como prestando apoio à coordenação na implementação de projetos de melhoria e no controle dos processos.
Responsibilities and assignments
Seus Desafios Serão
Elaborar e implementar os procedimentos operacionais padrão de higiene (POPH), instruções, procedimentos e métodos de ensaios da área da qualidade;
Realizar análises físico-químicas, microbiológicas e sensoriais em matérias-primas, ingredientes, produtos em processo e produtos acabados e manter os registros atualizados;
Analisar a procedência das reclamações recebidas através do Serviço de Atendimento ao Cliente e auxiliar na elaboração de planos de ações das reclamações de produtos (Serviço de Atendimento ao Cliente);
Monitorar a eficiência e a qualidade dos produtos e material de embalagem no processo de produção;
Realizar auditorias e treinamentos em boas práticas de fabricação, APPCC (análise de perigo e pontos críticos de controle) e de segurança de alimentos;
Elaborar e acompanhar o cronograma de calibrações dos equipamentos do laboratório de controle de qualidade;
Qualificar e avaliar os fornecedores de itens críticos (matérias-primas, ingredientes, embalagens e produtos de higiene);
Elaborar e revisar dizeres de rotulagem dos produtos.

Superior em Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Produção, Tecnologia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.

Estabelecer práticas escaláveis de CS para uma base grande (4k+ clientes).
Monitorar NPS, engajamento de produto e risco de churn.
Suporte

Reduzir tempo de resposta e eliminar gargalos de experiência.
Implementar melhorias contínuas a partir das demandas do suporte.

Desenvolver experimentos de growth baseados em dados.

Experiência prévia em plataformas SaaS B2B por assinatura.
Vivência em duas ou mais das áreas: Vendas, CS, Suporte, Growth ou RevOps.
Forte raciocínio analítico e visão de negócios.
Experiência com gestão de times multidisciplinares.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
JOB TITLE: QC Inspector – WAG Manifolds
CLIENT: Global Energy Operator
LOCATION: Rio, Brazil
ASSIGNMENT TYPE: Residential
START DATE: ASAP
CONTRACT LENGTH: Annually Renewable Contract
MISSIONS / SERVICE DIMENSIONS
The Service Provider will deliver QC services at the WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG. The role ensures the Contractor supplies WAG Manifolds and Foundations on schedule, in compliance with CLIENT HSE policies and required quality standards.
ACTIVITIES
The Service Provider will liaise with:
CPY Subsea HSE Lead
CPY Quality Lead
CPY Materials & Welding Lead
CPY Delivery Lead
HSE AND COMPLIANCE – THE SERVICE HOLDER SHALL:
Fully comply with site security, health, and safety requirements and maintain continuous hazard awareness
Demonstrate exemplary H3SE behaviour, complete required training, and follow CPY Subsea HSE Lead directives
Report issues/anomalies through site systems and apply STOP WORK when necessary
Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are performed effectively
Comply with Company Ethics and Code of Conduct, supporting Anti-Corruption initiatives
WORK TASKS
The Service Holder will ensure that work performed by CTR and sub-contractors complies with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations. Responsibilities include:
Conduct inspection of welds and welding processes in accordance with WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications
Perform inspections before, during, and after welding per ISO requirements
Apply extensive inspection experience (minimum 10 years) with CRA materials: Super Duplex (Pipe/Forging/HIPPED), Inconel 625, and LAS (F22)
Inspect buttering, overlay, and girth welding using Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables
Perform advanced NDT methods:
Visual
Ultrasonic
PAUT (Phased Array UT)
Magnetic Particle
Liquid Penetrant
Verify testing in accordance with ASME and DNV requirements
Review WPS and PQR to validate production compliance
Inspect incoming materials against specifications and mill certificates
Participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective actions
Identify and report deviations or quality issues impacting SPS equipment
Prepare weekly inspection reports
Coordinate with Company Site Representative and CPY Material Engineer on welding, NDT, and materials matters
Stop work in case of non-conformity and reassess prior to restart
Agree practical solutions with contractors that maintain quality without impacting schedule
Ensure timely closure of non-conformities
Monitor site welding activities and provide feedback to the project team
Participate in audits and follow up on corrective actions
CONTEXT & ENVIRONMENT
The service supports the execution phase of a major offshore development project. The multidisciplinary project team manages subsea systems, FPSO integration, and reservoir development.
Project objectives include:
Maximising economic performance
Optimising schedule, cost, and emissions
Maintaining high technical quality and H3SE standards
DURATION / LOCATION
Start Date: 1 March 2026
Duration: 1 year (renewable through fabrication until mid-2028)
Location: Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG
Status: Residential
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Experience with WAG Manifolds and subsea structures
15+ years of welding inspection experience
Certification as Welding Inspector: CWI / CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent)
NDT Level 3 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI)
Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Fluent English required (Portuguese and/or French an advantage)

title: Operations Geologist
description:
Entity:

Production & Operations


Job Family Group:

Subsurface Group


Job Description:

* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *

The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, aligned with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.

Essential Experience and Job Requirements:

  • Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
  • Demonstrated long-term experience of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
  • Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology.  Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
  • Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
  • Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
  • Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
  • Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
  • Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
  • Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.

In addition, it would be help if you had

  • Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells

Well Planning & Design:

  • HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
  • Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's  Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
  • Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
  • Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
  • Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
  • Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document

Geological Operations:

  • Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
  • Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
  • Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
  • Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
  • Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
  • Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.

Post Well:

  • Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
  • Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to interested parties
  • Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
  • Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators

Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and high-reaching environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.


Travel Requirement

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role


Relocation Assistance:

This role is not eligible for relocation


Remote Type:

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working


Skills:

Basin resource evaluation, Basin resource evaluation, CO2 utilisation and storage, Core acquisition and analysis, Cost-conscious decision-making, Data acquisition strategy, Data Management, Depositional framework, Fluid Properties, Fluid sampling and analysis, Geodesy and coordinate integrity, Geohazard Assessment, Geomechanical analysis, Integrated Well Delivery, Operations Geology, Petroleum Systems Analysis, Petrophysical Dynamic Reservoir Description, Petrophysical Seismic Lithology and Fluid Prediction, Petrophysical Static Reservoir Description, PPFG detection, Research and Development, Reservoir geomechanics, Reservoir quality, Seismic Interpretation, Seismic stratigraphic interpretation {+ 6 more}

description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de pacientes.

Descrição :

Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

- O que você irá realizar

  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);

  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;

  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;

  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;

  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;

  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;

  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;

  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;

  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;

  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;

  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;

  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;

  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;

  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);

  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.

- Esperamos que você tenha

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;

  • CRP ativo e regular;

  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;

  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;

  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais

- Local de trabalho:   Rio de Janeiro

- Oferecemos:   Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

As a Senior Fullstack React & Java Engineer, you will play a key role in architecting and building features across the stack, with special emphasis on creating responsive, intuitive web applications that integrate seamlessly with a modern microservices ecosystem.

Deep understanding of domain-driven design (DDD) and modular service design.

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.

Requirements

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar environments.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.

Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 5 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a  sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 6 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work.

Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Analista de Inteligência Comercial Pleno , que irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Growth Team, mais especificamente na área de Experiência do Cliente, sendo responsável por:

  • Atuar como ponte estratégica entre análise de dados e geração de receita, com foco em identificar e priorizar oportunidades de up-sell e cross-sell dentro da base de clientes;

  • Transformar indicadores de consumo e engajamento em planos de ação comerciais claros, acionáveis e orientados a resultado;

  • Conduzir análises comparativas de clientes, avaliando potencial de crescimento e sugerindo priorizações para otimização da receita;
  • Desenvolver análises e relatórios que subsidiam decisões de negócio, incluindo tendências de consumo, padrões de uso e oportunidades de monetização;

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com os times de Customer Experience, Pré-vendas e Vendas, apoiando abordagens consultivas e estratégias de expansão, quando necessário.

Entendemos que para atender as demandas da vaga, é necessário que o candidato possua:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de Vendas Consultivas;

Na IPNET by Vivo, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil: um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções/Sede Eco Berrini).

Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade. 

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado. 

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.


Modelo de trabalho 
Presencial

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada 


Liderança:

  • Formar sucessores, construir times de alta performance e garantir a qualidade das contratações de novos consultores com base em critérios técnicos e comportamentais;
  • Garantir o onboarding de novos colaboradores, proporcionando um ambiente acolhedor e seguro para o início das vendas;

  • Identificar as prioridades das tarefas e distribuí-las de forma adequada;
  • Auxiliar e orientar os consultores no fechamento das vendas;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho e os resultados, promovendo feedbacks constantes para o aprimoramento da equipe;
  • Disseminar o Jeito Agi, sendo fiel aos Comportamentos Corporativos;
  • Reconhecer pequenas e grandes conquistas da equipe comercial, mantendo um bom clima e engajamento;
  • Atuar efetivamente nas vendas junto à equipe, evoluindo os scripts de abordagem e demonstrando na prática como proceder em todas as vias de negócios (Físico, Digital, Remoto e Externo).

Operacional:

  • Orientar e atuar ativamente junto à equipe de vendas sobre os procedimentos internos, regras e políticas da empresa, condições de vendas em vigor, campanhas promocionais, produtos em lançamento e novas estratégias de marketing;

  • Avaliar a qualidade e veracidade das operações contratadas;

title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc. ), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra-estrutura do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas. Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças. Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos. Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia. Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção. Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

title: Senior Operations Geologist
description:
Entity:

Production & Operations


Job Family Group:

Subsurface Group


Job Description:

* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *

The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, stays in sync with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.

Essential Experience and Job Requirements:

  • Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
  • Seasoned professional of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
  • Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology.  Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
  • Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
  • Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
  • Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
  • Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
  • Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
  • Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.

In addition, it would be help if you had

  • Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells

Well Planning & Design:

  • HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
  • Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's  Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
  • Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
  • Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
  • Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
  • Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document

Geological Operations:

  • Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
  • Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
  • Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
  • Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
  • Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
  • Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.

Post Well:

  • Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
  • Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners
  • Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
  • Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators

Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and high-reaching environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.


Travel Requirement

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role


Relocation Assistance:

This role is not eligible for relocation


Remote Type:

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working


Skills:

Basin resource evaluation, Basin resource evaluation, CO2 utilisation and storage, Core acquisition and analysis, Cost-conscious decision-making, Data acquisition strategy, Data Management, Depositional framework, Fluid Properties, Fluid sampling and analysis, Geodesy and coordinate integrity, Geohazard Assessment, Geomechanical analysis, Integrated Well Delivery, Operations Geology, Petroleum Systems Analysis, Petrophysical Dynamic Reservoir Description, Petrophysical Seismic Lithology and Fluid Prediction, Petrophysical Static Reservoir Description, PPFG detection, Research and Development, Reservoir geomechanics, Reservoir quality, Seismic Interpretation, Seismic stratigraphic interpretation {+ 6 more}

title: Principal Clinical Research Associate/ Senior Clinical Research Associate
description:
About CTI
CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit
What You'll Do
Serve as main CTI contact for assigned study sites
Conduct site visits (pre-study (PSV), site initiation (SIV), interim monitoring (IMV), and close-out (COV)) and complete site visit deliverables with quality and within given timelines in Monitoring Plan while adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements, SOPs and ICH GCP
Assist with study start-up activities, including feasibility, pre-study activities and site selection
Collect, review and track essential/regulatory documents
Participate in and complete all general and study specific training as required
Participate in investigator, client and project team meetings;may include presentations
Create and implement subject enrollment strategies for assigned study sites
Ensure proper storage, dispensation and accountability of all Investigational Product (IP) and trial-related materials
Perform site management activities and provide ongoing updates of site status to Clinical Project Manager
Conduct remote monitoring and complete the related activities in accordance with study specific Monitoring Plan
Utilize systems and reports to track subject status, subject case report form (CRF) retrieval / source document review (SDV), regulatory documents, and IP
Assist with project-specific activities as member of Project Team Monitoring Plan, etc.)
Participate in the development of CRFs and other study related documents (subject worksheets, Monitoring Plan, etc.)
Perform translation, customization, and review of Patient Information sheet and Informed Consent, protocol synopsis and other study applicable documents as per required procedures
Where applicable, provide support to Regulatory Affairs Study Start-up Team in the preparation or revision of documentation for submission to Ethics Committee(s), Institutions Ethics Committees, Regulatory Authorities, Competent Authorities or Institutions Administration Boards, and follow-up the evaluation process until approval is available. Provide regular updates to Sponsor/ Client
Where applicable, support in contract negotiation with study sites, Investigator payments and tracking of site payments
Manage ISF and TMF for all assigned study sites in accordance with SOPs or study-specific Monitoring Plans
Identify an anticipate site issues and implement corrective actions or escalate as appropriate
Liaise with Clinical Data Management for data cleaning activities
Serve as mentor/trainer for CRAs; may include conducting training/assessment visits
Function in the role of Lead CRA for assigned projects(s0
What You Bring
At least 5-8 years of clinical trial monitoring experience or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
Fluent in English
Bachelor's Degree or higher in allied health field such as nursing, pharmacy, or health / natural science, or RN with Associate's Degree, or 3-year Nursing Diploma with at least 2 years clinical nursing experience, or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
Previous experience in conducting clinical research studies in hospital setting, pharmaceutical company or CRO
You need to be fully eligible to work in Brazil - (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul/Santa Catarina)
Proficiency in Spanish is considered an asset
Why CTI?
We support career progression – We have a structured mentoring program to provide the support you need to move forward
We value education and training – We provide tuition reimbursement, partner with universities and colleges to create programs in our field, and have a dedicated training department
We value our people - We have never had a layoff in our 20-year history, support a work-life balance, and have provided cash bonuses every year for the past decade
Our culture is unparalleled – We've received multiple awards recognizing CTI as one of the best places to work in the greater Cincinnati area, as well as one of the top CROs in the industry
We think globally and act locally – We have a global philanthropic program supporting our team's efforts to improve their local communities (click here to learn more about our "CTI Cares" program)
We are looking toward the future – We have had a consistent double-digit growth rate over the last decade, invest in cutting-edge technology, and pride ourselves on our average 95% annual retention rate (a recent report found that the average turnover for CROs in the US was 30%)
Our work makes a difference – We focus our work on treatments for chronically and critically-ill patients, who are depending on us to bring these life-changing therapies to market
Important Note
In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website ) or from our verified LinkedIn page.
Please Note
We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.

Training Material Development & Delivery:

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.

Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination:

  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Estamos constantemente a procura de profissionais conectados com o nosso propósito, que sejam apaixonados por impactar vidas e que queiram construir carreira.
Valorizamos as diferenças e entendemos que elas favorecem o crescimento pessoal e profissional, amplia a capacidade de entender e estimula o respeito à individualidade e privacidade do ser humano.
Se identificou com a gente? Então inscreva-se para ter a oportunidade de participar de nosso processo seletivo e fazer parte da nossa história

No Bradesco valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Por isso, as nossas vagas são abertas a todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência, idade ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Ajudante de Copa
description:
Do you know Club Med?
We have nearly 70 Resorts, open summer and winter, in 26 countries. We offer top-of-the-range vacations in the mountains and by the sea. Our customers are looking for happiness and freedom.

Why are you reading this ad? Because you want to be part of that little something extra that makes us different. You have the human and professional skills we're looking for.

We offer you the chance to grow and develop very quickly by joining our brilliant teams. You'll be able to travel the world.

Your working environment
Each Resort has several restaurants and bars, both event-oriented and more intimate, serving our Premium All Inclusive offer. These spaces allow guests to reconnect with each other, and set the pace for every highlight of the day. From the buffet to the bistronomic restaurant, from the theme bar to the tasting cellar, you'll find yourself in a multi-faceted environment. Our refined offering is built around 5 pillars: creating memorable experiences, surprising with a multitude of conceptual catering spaces, working towards the well-being of everyone (including your own), playing on the emotions and senses through staging, all in a fun, relaxed atmosphere.

You are

  • Sociable, you know how to connect with our customers and establish a relationship of trust.
  • Efficient, you have a sense of priorities and limit waiting times
  • Attentive, you offer a personalized service to each and every one of our customers.

You will

  • Be in charge of cleaning, sanitizing and disinfecting kitchens, back offices, bars and restaurants, washrooms and garbage rooms
  • Handle TDC and detergents for the Food & Beverage departments, and ensure their proper storage
  • Participate in the inventory and alert your manager to any TDC and detergent requirements for the smooth running of the service
  • Take charge of the cleaning and maintenance of the equipment in the Food & Beverage department's garbage rooms.
  • Evacuate, empty and clean waste garbage cans in compliance with health and safety standards.

Joining our teams is also a unique opportunity to live and work with people from all walks of life, in some of the world's most Instagrammable locations.

You'll gain valuable experience on your CV, working for a company that supports and trains you on an ongoing basis to help you become the best version of yourself.

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Conheça a empresa Rede D'Or


Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

title: Auxiliar Mecânico de Refrigeração
description:
Execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos de climatização, abrangendo atividades como limpeza técnica, reapertos, inspeções de funcionamento, medições elétricas e termodinâmicas, identificação e substituição de componentes defeituosos (compressores, placas eletrônicas, sensores, válvulas, ventiladores, entre outros). O profissional também será responsável por realizar testes de funcionamento e operação dos sistemas, registrar os serviços executados nos formulários ou sistemas digitais utilizados pela contratada e atuar em conformidade com os padrões de segurança, qualidade e desempenho estabelecidos pela empresa. Prestam assistência técnica, instalam, realizam manutenção e modernização em aparelhos de climatização e refrigeração, de acordo com normas de segurança e qualidade. Orçam serviços e elaboram documentação técnica. Especificam materiais, executam rotinas estabelecidas pelo Encarregado/Coordenador de Manutenção e Supervisores, e fornecem feedbacks sobre o andamento dos serviços. Ensino médio completo e curso profissionalizante em Mecânica de Refrigeração, sendo desejável formação técnica em Refrigeração. É imprescindível possuir certificação específica em sistemas VRF (tais como LG, Daikin, Fujitsu, Midea ou similares), bem como experiência comprovada na manutenção de sistemas de climatização do tipo VRF, Fancoil, Split, AC e Chiller. É necessário a apresentação das certificações atualizadas NR-10 e NR-35, além de conhecimento na leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos e manuais técnicos.

Plan, execute, and optimize prospecting and cold outreach campaigns using sales automation tools and networking techniques to maximize conversion.
Manage the full cycle of consultative IT service sales: prospecting, diagnosis, proposal presentation, negotiation, and closing.
Collaborate with the Marketing, Delivery, and Operations teams, sharing market insights and feedback to enhance commercial strategies and ensure a smooth client experience.
Monitor key metrics (pipeline, conversion, revenue) and propose improvements in lead generation and client management processes.
Participate in networking events and activities in the U.S. or LATAM, representing the company to clients and strategic partners.
Support the client experience throughout the sales cycle, ensuring satisfaction, retention, and growth (cross-selling / up-selling).

Advanced or bilingual English (required).
Proven experience selling IT, software, or staffing services (required).
Knowledge and experience using CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, SugarCRM).
Experience in automating cold outreach campaigns.
Availability to travel and attend international fairs or events.
Soft Skills:
Results-oriented mindset: constant focus on achieving sales goals.
Autonomy and proactivity: ability to generate opportunities and solve challenges independently and creatively.
Commercial drive: ability to maintain prospecting momentum and stay motivated through the challenges of the sales process.
Positive attitude: enthusiasm for growth and commitment to achieving results.

An exciting growth journey and an endless ambition to evolve as a company.

Opportunities for professional development and personal growth.
Passionate, high-performing, and genuine colleagues.

Local holidays.
15 business days of PTO and a flexibility program.

We believe our greatest value lies in our human capital, building long-lasting relationships that go beyond simple deliverables.
You'll be part of a Latin American company with expert teams that can enrich your knowledge. Thanks to our flexible work model, we harness the talent of collaborators located in different regions across the world.
Our Core Values:
Reliable: we build trustworthy and genuine relationships with both internal and external clients.

title: Gerente Sênior de Crescimento
description:
1. COMO É SER GERENTE (SÊNIOR) DE CRESCIMENTO EM MSF-BRASIL:
Você irá desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento e de melhoria contínua do retorno sobre investimento das ações de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil, maximizando a contribuição para os projetos médico-humanitários da organização pelo mundo. Irá trabalhar para encantar, conquistar e fidelizar pessoas doadoras por meio de engajamento contínuo, diversificando canais e garantindo a sustentabilidade do programa de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil a longo prazo.
Além disso, deverá desenvolver e incentivar estratégias ousadas, inovadoras, orientadas por dados e que reforcem a marca de MSF, fomentando uma relação com pessoas doadoras pautadas pela ética e transparência, visando sempre a segurança e privacidade de dados. Atuando em estreita colaboração com outras lideranças, garantindo uma abordagem alinhada com a estratégia de MSF-Brasil como um todo e assegurando que o crescimento seja conduzido de forma ética, inclusiva e responsável, considerando a diversidade de públicos, contextos e impactos das estratégias adotadas.
2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?
Ampliar a base de pessoas doadoras ativas de MSF-Brasil, buscando caminhos inovadores para enfrentar os diferentes desafios no mercado e considerando cada etapa do funil de crescimento;
Aumentar a receita de MSF-Brasil, garantindo eficiência nas atividades de crescimento e buscando maximizar Retorno sobre Investimento (ROI);
Promover cultura de captação de recursos na organização, equilibrando crescimento, inovação e performance com decisões éticas, inclusivas e alinhadas aos valores institucionais.
3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?
Atividades de Crescimento e Estratégia
Zelar pela qualidade das entregas da célula, junto aos responsáveis das áreas, garantindo o atendimento às demandas com qualidade;
Assegurar que os processos de compras, pagamentos e reports são cumpridos pela célula de acordo com os prazos definidos;
Garantir gestão e monitoramento completo do funil de crescimento, desde a consciência e aquisição de pessoas doadoras até a fidelização e indicação, e identificação de oportunidades para otimizar o desempenho em cada etapa do funil por meio do monitoramento constante de métricas;
Garantir experimentação e implementação de novos canais e abordagens para expandir alcance e performance junto às lideranças da célula e em colaboração estreita com o time de Business Intelligence (BI);
Garantir otimização constante da experiência de pessoas usuárias, Régua de Relacionamento e atendimento a pessoas doadoras, zelando pela qualidade de cada contato e considerando abordagem inovadora e omnichannel;
Assegurar que experiências, réguas e abordagens considerem diferentes perfis, capacidades de acesso, contextos culturais e expectativas, evitando práticas excludentes e fortalecendo relações sustentáveis com pessoas doadoras;
Trabalhar com líderes na célula para melhorar processos e fluxos junto às outras células no hub de Engajamento Estratégico em busca de melhor eficiência e agilidade nas atividades;
Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Filantropia no planejamento e implementação de estratégias para desenvolver pessoas doadoras, tanto pessoas físicas quanto jurídicas, visando aumentar suas contribuições e direcioná-los à categoria de grandes doações, com atendimento personalizado pela equipe de Filantropia;
Garantir potencial de otimização da área de sistemas junto a Gerência de Sistemas e GTT através de investimentos em novas tecnologias;
Garantir que a célula de crescimento contribui e segue processos de certificação de PCI compliance de MSF e segurança de dados conforme LGPD e políticas de MSF;
Negociar as melhores condições de parceria de fornecedores de MSF-Brasil junto as lideranças na célula;
Contribuir para projetos de alto nível do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, conforme necessário;
Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento de MSF-Brasil, envolvendo as áreas interessadas e garantindo participação ativa de suas equipes na construção;
Definir, sustentar e responsabilizar-se pela incorporação de princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão nas estratégias, decisões, prioridades e práticas da célula de crescimento, influenciando lideranças, equipes e parceiros e promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e coerente com os valores de MSF;
Garantir participação e acompanhamento de plataformas internacionais relevantes para MSF-Brasil, trazendo ideias inovadoras e adaptando para o cenário brasileiro;
Promoção de cultura de Captação de Recursos
Ser responsável pela construção de uma cultura de captação de recursos em MSF-Brasil, garantindo a consistência dos programas oferecidos para as pessoas funcionarias, conscientizando a organização sobre a importância de captação de recursos e relacionamento com as pessoas doadoras;
Compartilhar insights e performance da área com outros departamentos da organização continuamente, assegurando trabalho transversal;
Participar e contribuir com o fórum de ONGs no Brasile plataformas internacionais, trazendo insumos relevantes do mercado e ideias inovadoras, adaptando para o cenário de MSF-Brasil;
Influenciar a cultura organizacional para que práticas de captação e relacionamento sejam compreendidas e realizadas de forma ética, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores institucionais;
Compromissos de gestão de MSF-Brasil
Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, promovendo uma gestão de pessoas ética, equitativa e inclusiva, que valorize a escuta ativa, fomente uma cultura de feedback contínuo e incentive o desenvolvimento profissional;
Aplicar e disseminar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios da organização;
Favorecer a colaboração entre áreas e o trabalho transversal, desenvolvendo e aprimorando processos integrados com olhar estratégico;
Contribuir ativamente para o Planejamento Estratégico e Plano Anual, participando de monitoramentos periódicos, identificando riscos e ajustando prioridades com responsabilidade e visão sistêmica;
Garantir a implementação e promoção ativa de práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), valorizando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e promovendo um ambiente seguro para todas as pessoas;
Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança
Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
Basear e incentivar decisões em dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação do Hub, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura "data-driven" e metodologia ágil.
Requisitos
4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?
Formação relevante na área
Sólida experiência em liderança de crescimento e captação de recursos
Experiência com gestão de pessoas e canais diversos de marketing
Ter domínio do inglês (avançado)
Conhecimentos de estratégia de marketing e análise de resultados, propostas, tendências
Conhecimentos de metodologia ágil e gestão de projetos
Conhecimentos de CRMs, bancos de dados e Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD)
Conhecimentos de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão e aplicação em liderança
5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?
Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas
Experiência prévia em Médicos Sem Fronteiras ou outras organizações do terceiro setor
Vivência com estratégias de crescimento voltadas para causas humanitárias ou sociais

O Grupo 3corações é construído por pessoas, antes de tudo, apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Temos orgulho de crescer pela força do trabalho e seguir, cada vez mais longe, sem esquecer a nossa essência e os nossos valores. É pelo nosso jeito simples de ser que celebramos a diversidade de pessoas e as experiências saborosas que entrelaçam histórias. O resultado é uma companhia com produtos de qualidade, colaboradores e consumidores felizes, fornecedores e parceiros integrados em uma mesma missão proporcionar experiências prazerosas que promovam alegria e bem-estar, criando laços duradouros e gerando valor para todos. O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho, valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe.
